GoRoute AI Gateway is engineered from the ground up to be maintainable, verifiable, and extensible by both human software engineers and autonomous AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Google Antigravity). To guarantee that agent-generated pull requests maintain architectural invariants, code quality, and security boundaries, the codebase incorporates a hierarchical context architecture consisting of: Root CLAUDE.md: Compact project instructions and essential commands (under 100 lines). Modular .claude/rules/: Scoped sub-domain guidelines (go-backend.md, frontend-web.md, api-contracts.md). Universal AGENTS.md: Portable repository guidance for all autonomous agent engines. Deterministic Verification Loops: Non-interactive commands to validate syntax, typing, static analysis, race conditions, contracts, and frontend bundle budgets.

The root CLAUDE.md file serves as the immediate instruction entrypoint for Claude Code sessions. To ensure high token efficiency, it is maintained under a strict 100-line limit while establishing the 7 core repository invariants: CLAUDE.md: Under 100 Lines(Immediate Context) 1. Micro-Dollar FinOps (Integer Arithmetic) 2. SSRF & Egress Protection (internal/security/network) 3. Fail-Closed 4-Layer RBAC (Org/Team/User/Key) 4. AES-256-GCM Credential Vault 5. Contract-Guided Specs (OpenAPI 3.1 & Protos) 6. Single-Binary Embedded UI (Under 400 KB Budget) 7. Immutable Model Pricing Audit History

Integer Micro-Dollar FinOps: All financial and spend calculations must use 64-bit integer micro-dollars (1 USD = 1,000,000 micro-dollars) with intermediate pico-dollar precision. Never use floating-point types (float32 / float64) for money. SSRF & Outbound Egress Protection: Outbound network requests must use internal/security/network safe HTTP transport (SafeTransport, DialContext). Never use raw unvalidated http.DefaultClient or unpinned IPs for provider egress. Fail-Closed RBAC & Auth: Multi-tenant authorization (internal/auth/rbac.go) is strictly fail-closed across all 4 tiers (Organization → Team → User → Virtual Key). Credential Vault: Upstream provider API keys and secrets must remain encrypted via AES-256-GCM (internal/storage/vault.go) at rest and in transit. Contract-Guided Architecture: API and wire contracts are defined in docs/openapi/gateway.openapi.yaml, docs/specs/mcp/, and docs/specs/a2a/. Verify contracts with go run ./cmd/specgen. Single-Binary Web UI Embedding: The Operator UI in web/ compiles into internal/ui/dist/ and is embedded via Go embed.FS (//go:embed all:dist). Total frontend bundle size must strictly respect budget constraints (under 400 KB total; verified via web/scripts/check-budget.mjs). Immutable Pricing History: Model pricing updates must append an immutable audit record to model_pricing_history.

Rather than crowding the root prompt with domain-specific rules, the repository utilizes modular rule definitions located in .claude/rules/. AI agents activate these instructions dynamically based on the files they touch.

Located at .claude/rules/go-backend.md, this guide enforces Go idioms and safety standards: Strict Dependency Direction: Package dependencies point strictly inward toward domain definitions in internal/domain: cmd/: Application entrypoints (cmd/gateway, cmd/specgen, cmd/catalog-sync). pkg/: Public, stable, embeddable SDKs (pkg/gateway). internal/: Private implementation packages (internal/server, internal/router, internal/adapter, etc.). internal/domain/: Foundational domain types, interfaces, request/response models, and error codes. Chi Router Conventions: Handlers follow standard http.HandlerFunc signatures: func (s *GatewayServer) handleX(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request). Path parameters extracted via chi.URLParam(r, "paramName"). Query parameters extracted via r.URL.Query().Get("key"). JSON serialization via writeJSON(w, statusCode, data). Unified error serialization via domain.WriteHTTPError(w, err). Zero-Allocation Hot Path: Hot inference routes (POST /v1/chat/completions) must avoid unnecessary heap allocations, redundant JSON reflection, or blocking synchronous database writes. Safe Network Egress: Direct instantiation of &http.Client{} is prohibited. All outbound requests must use network.NewSafeTransport with DNS pinning, private IP filtering, and link-local address blocking.

Located at .claude/rules/frontend-web.md, this guide establishes rules for modifying the Operator Web UI: Technology Stack: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v3 (dark mode enabled via slate/zinc palette). Icon Imports: Use lucide-react with tree-shaking named imports (e.g. import { Activity, Shield } from 'lucide-react'). Avoid importing the entire library to prevent bundle bloat. Bundle Budget Verification: Every pull request modifying web/ must pass check-budget.mjs with uncompressed size under 380 KB and gzip under 110 KB. Distribution Synchronization: When frontend source files are changed, make ui-build must be executed to rebuild the bundle and sync artifacts to internal/ui/dist/ before committing.

Located at .claude/rules/api-contracts.md, this rule governs wire formats and backwards compatibility: Authoritative Contract Files: Gateway OpenAPI: docs/openapi/gateway.openapi.yaml (OpenAPI 3.1.0). MCP OpenAPI & Schema: docs/openapi/mcp.openapi.yaml and docs/specs/mcp/2026-07-28/schema.json. A2A OpenAPI & Protobuf: docs/openapi/a2a.openapi.yaml and docs/specs/a2a/v1.0/a2a.proto. Validation Utility: Agents must execute go run ./cmd/specgen to ensure that route schemas, protobuf definitions, and documentation match the Go code. Attribution Headers: Responses must include standard attribution telemetry (X-Gateway-Request-Id, X-Gateway-Provider, X-Gateway-Model, X-Gateway-Cost-Micros, X-Gateway-Routing-Time, X-Gateway-Cache).

AGENTS.md is the cross-engine specification file designed for tools like Cursor, Copilot Workspace, Antigravity, and autonomous agent loops. It emphasizes: Codebase Mapping: Directs agents to read docs/CODEBASE_MAP.md before exploring code. Change Expectations: Agents must state the exact commands executed and tests run in their change summaries. Preservation of Unrelated Work: Agents must not revert, rewrite, or touch unrelated code or user changes. Self-Correction Strategy: When a test fails or go vet produces warnings, agents must inspect the failure, apply the minimal targeted fix, and rerun the test suite rather than disabling tests.

Autonomous agents must execute the deterministic verification pipeline before declaring any task complete. The commands below are fast, reproducible, and runnable locally or in CI: Step Verification Goal Command Success Criteria 1. Formatting Check Go code formatting gofmt -l . Output must be empty (0 files listed). 2. Static Analysis Go type and idiom validation go vet ./... Exits with return code 0; zero warnings. 3. API Specs Validate OpenAPI & Protobuf contracts go run ./cmd/specgen Passes contract validation without errors. 4. Unit Tests Concurrent race detection go test -race -count=1 ./internal/... ./pkg/... All package unit tests pass under Go race detector. 5. Focused Test Rapid feedback during edits go test -v -race -run <TestName> ./internal/<pkg>/... Specified unit test passes cleanly. 6. Frontend Build Build UI & verify bundle budget make ui-build Passes Vite build and check-budget.mjs threshold. 7. UI Dist Sync Confirm embedded dist is mirrored make ui-check-dist git status shows zero uncommitted diffs in internal/ui/dist. 8. Binary Build Compile production executable go build ./cmd/gateway Produces executable binary gateway. 9. Full Check Comprehensive pre-flight check make release-check All verification checks pass end-to-end.

Agents can run this one-line verification recipe to confirm entire repository integrity: gofmt -l . && go vet ./... && go test -race -count=1 ./internal/server ./internal/router ./internal/auth && go build ./cmd/gateway [!TIP] When testing data plane changes without running live upstream providers, use the built-in mock provider adapter (internal/adapter/mock.go) or the lightweight local test server (configs/config.yaml) to achieve 100% deterministic test coverage without network dependencies.

GoRoute AI Gateway supports a layered configuration architecture: Built-in Defaults: Hardcoded, zero-dependency defaults optimized for instant developer startup. Declarative YAML (configs/config.yaml): Structured configuration defining storage backends, security boundaries, rate limits, model groups, and routing topologies. Environment Variable Overrides (GATEWAY_* / os.environ/VAR): Production overrides for Kubernetes ConfigMaps, container runtime secrets, and 12-factor cloud deployments. Go SDK Options (pkg/gateway): In-process configuration primitives for embedded architectures.

Set your upstream provider API keys directly in your shell or container definition. The gateway automatically spins up an in-memory repository, provisions an AES-256-GCM vault, and configures default model aliases: # Frontier LLM Providers export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-proj-..." export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-ant-..." export GEMINI_API_KEY="AIzaSy..." export MISTRAL_API_KEY="mis_..." # Enterprise Cloud Hyperscalers export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="AKIA..." export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="..." export AWS_REGION="us-east-1" export GCP_PROJECT_ID="my-gcp-project" export GCP_REGION="us-central1" # Gateway Master Secrets export GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY="sk-gw-master-secret-passphrase-change-me" export GATEWAY_MASTER_ENCRYPTION_KEY="0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef" # Launch Gateway ./ai-gateway

Supply the path to your YAML configuration file via the -config CLI argument: ./ai-gateway -config /etc/goroute/config.yaml The gateway resolves environment variable secret placeholders matching os.environ/VARIABLE_NAME inside strings dynamically during YAML parsing: model_params: model: "openai/gpt-4o" api_key: "os.environ/OPENAI_API_KEY"

The model_list array defines the virtual routing topology presented to clients.

Each entry in model_list defines: model_name: The virtual alias or model identifier requested by the client (e.g., "fast", "reasoning", "gpt-4o"). routing_strategy: The balancing algorithm across sibling deployments ("weighted-shuffle", "least-busy", "latency-based", "lowest-cost", "usage-based-headroom"). fallbacks: Explicit root-level array of fallback model names triggered when this model group experiences an outage, exhausted retries, or rate limit rejections. model_params: Upstream target configuration (model, api_key, weight, rpm, tpm, azure_deployment_name, etc.). HTTP 429 / 5xx & Retries Exhausted HTTP 429 / 5xx & Retries Exhausted Success Client Request: model: 'gpt-4o' Primary Group: gpt-4o(openai/gpt-4o) Fallback 1: claude-3-5-sonnet(anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet) Fallback 2: gemini-2.5-pro(gemini/gemini-2.5-pro) 200 OK (X-Gateway-Provider: gemini)

model_list: # Primary Tier: GPT-4o with cross-cloud fallbacks - model_name: "gpt-4o" routing_strategy: "weighted-shuffle" fallbacks: - "claude-3-5-sonnet" - "gemini-2.5-pro" model_params: model: "openai/gpt-4o" api_key: "os.environ/OPENAI_API_KEY" weight: 100 rpm: 1000 tpm: 80000 # Fallback Tier 1: Claude 3.5 Sonnet - model_name: "claude-3-5-sonnet" routing_strategy: "latency-based" fallbacks: - "gemini-2.5-pro" model_params: model: "anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022" api_key: "os.environ/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" weight: 100 # Fallback Tier 2: Gemini 2.5 Pro - model_name: "gemini-2.5-pro" routing_strategy: "weighted-shuffle" model_params: model: "gemini/gemini-2.5-pro" api_key: "os.environ/GEMINI_API_KEY" weight: 100 # High-Throughput "fast" Group: Multi-Provider Load Balancing - model_name: "fast" routing_strategy: "least-busy" fallbacks: - "fast-backup" model_params: model: "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash" api_key: "os.environ/GEMINI_API_KEY" weight: 70 - model_name: "fast" routing_strategy: "least-busy" model_params: model: "openai/gpt-4o-mini" api_key: "os.environ/OPENAI_API_KEY" weight: 30 # Emergency Local Backup - model_name: "fast-backup" routing_strategy: "weighted-shuffle" model_params: model: "ollama/llama3.3" api_base: "http://localhost:11434" weight: 100 [!IMPORTANT] The fallbacks: [...] slice is declared at the root level of each model_list entry alongside model_name and model_params. It must never be nested inside the model_params object. The router traverses fallbacks strictly in listed order, respecting circuit breaker states for each candidate before dispatching.

GoRoute AI Gateway supports two operational storage modes: In-Memory Mode (storage.mode: memory): Zero external dependencies. Ideal for local unit testing, CI pipelines, and ephemeral container runs. Secrets are kept in-process in an AES-256-GCM vault, but state does not survive process restarts. Clustered PostgreSQL + Redis (storage.mode: postgres): The enterprise production topology. PostgreSQL provides ACID durability for multi-tenant organizations, model catalogs, encrypted credentials, virtual keys, audit trails, stateful files, and asynchronous batch jobs. Redis provides distributed L2 key caching, atomic sliding-window rate limiting, response caching, circuit breaker state, and real-time Pub/Sub streams. Inference & Management Clients Gateway Cluster Pods Clustered Persistence Layer OpenAI / Anthropic SDKs Operator Web UI (/ui/) MCP / A2A Clients GoRoute Pod 1 GoRoute Pod 2 PostgreSQL 16+(16 Persistent Tables & Migrations) Redis 7+(L2 Caching, Rate Limiting, Pub/Sub)

The gateway automatically manages its database schema at startup using embedded SQL migration scripts located in migrations/. Migrations are applied sequentially inside an atomic transaction. Migration File Description Core Operations 0001_init_schema.up.sql Core Schema Initialization Enables pgcrypto. Creates base multi-tenant tables (global_models, organizations, org_provider_subscriptions, org_model_policies, teams, users, virtual_keys, provider_credentials, model_groups, model_deployments, spend_logs, audit_logs). 0002_add_platform_modules.up.sql Platform Governance & Guardrails Introduces model_pricing_history (immutable audit log of token pricing changes) and guardrail_policies (PII masking and prompt injection rules). 0003_add_mcp_and_a2a.up.sql MCP Hub & A2A Network Tables Creates MCP entity tables (mcp_servers, mcp_tools, mcp_toolsets, mcp_user_credentials) and A2A tables (a2a_agents, a2a_tasks, a2a_task_events, a2a_stream_publications, a2a_outbox_events, a2a_push_notification_configs). 0004_add_pricing_status.up.sql Pricing Provenance & Azure Fields Adds pricing_status, pricing_provenance_source, and pricing_effective_date to global_models and spend_logs. Adds azure_deployment_name and api_version to provider_credentials. Backfills audited seed models. 0005_add_model_capabilities.up.sql Persistent Capabilities & Provenance Adds capabilities JSONB column to global_models for tri-state capabilities tracking. Adds pricing_status and pricing_provenance_source to model_pricing_history. 0006_add_supports_inference.up.sql Non-Inference Product Segregation Adds supports_inference boolean flag to global_models to distinguish callable LLM deployments from ancillary catalog products. 0007_add_modality_pricing_and_spend.up.sql Multi-Modal Spend & Batch Assets Adds modality pricing columns (rerank_cost_micros_per_search_unit, image_cost_micros_base, audio_stt_cost_micros_per_second, etc.) to global_models, adds modality and modality_units JSONB to spend_logs, and creates files and batches tables.

Stores the unified catalog of all discovered and manually registered LLMs across providers. CREATE TABLE global_models ( id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, -- e.g. "openai/gpt-4o", "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash" provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, model_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, max_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 128000, max_output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 16384, supports_streaming BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, supports_tools BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, supports_vision BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, supports_reasoning BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, supports_embeddings BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, supports_inference BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, capabilities JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, input_cost_micros_per_1m BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, output_cost_micros_per_1m BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cached_input_cost_micros_per_1m BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reasoning_cost_micros_per_1m BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rerank_cost_micros_per_search_unit BIGINT DEFAULT 0, image_cost_micros_base BIGINT DEFAULT 0, image_cost_micros_hd BIGINT DEFAULT 0, audio_stt_cost_micros_per_second BIGINT DEFAULT 0, audio_tts_cost_micros_per_1k_chars BIGINT DEFAULT 0, modality_pricing_json JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, pricing_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', pricing_provenance_source VARCHAR(255), pricing_effective_date VARCHAR(64), lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', deprecation_date TIMESTAMPTZ, metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, discovered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE (provider, model_name) );

Multi-tenant root container managing corporate spend caps, RPM/TPM ceilings, and billing cycles. CREATE TABLE organizations ( id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::text, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, slug VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE, max_budget_micros BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- 0 = unlimited spent_micros BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, budget_reset_period VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', -- 'daily', 'monthly', 'never' budget_reset_at TIMESTAMPTZ, rpm_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tpm_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() );

Layer 2 governance controlling which upstream cloud providers an organization is permitted to call. CREATE TABLE org_provider_subscriptions ( org_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, auto_enable_new BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, subscribed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), PRIMARY KEY (org_id, provider) );

Layer 3 governance allowing or forbidding specific catalog models within an organization. CREATE TABLE org_model_policies ( org_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, global_model_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES global_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, approved_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), PRIMARY KEY (org_id, global_model_id) );

Sub-organizational entities representing engineering squads, divisions, or departments. CREATE TABLE teams ( id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::text, org_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, max_budget_micros BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, spent_micros BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, budget_reset_period VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', budget_reset_at TIMESTAMPTZ, rpm_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tpm_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, allowed_models TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE (org_id, name) );

Individual human operators or service accounts bound to organizations and teams. CREATE TABLE users ( id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::text, org_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, team_id VARCHAR(64) REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member', -- 'admin', 'member', 'read_only' is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE (org_id, email) );

Client authentication bearer tokens with rate limits, budgets, and model allowlists. Redis acts as the distributed execution fabric for clustered gateway pods. All keys are namespaced with the gw: prefix. request. gw:rl:rpm:key:{keyID}:{minute} String (Int) window_seconds * 2 (120s) Rate Limiter: Sliding-minute requests counter for virtual key. gw:rl:tpm:key:{keyID}:{minute} String (Int) window_seconds * 2 (120s) Rate Limiter: Sliding-minute tokens counter for virtual key. gw:rl:conc:{keyID} String (Int) rate_limit.concurrency_ttl_sec (300s) Rate Limiter: Atomic lease counter tracking concurrent in-flight requests. gw:spend:key:{keyID} String (Int) None (Persistent Counter) FinOps: Fast in-memory spend accumulator for virtual key. gw:rl:rpm:team:{teamID}:{minute} String (Int) window_seconds * 2 (120s) Rate Limiter: Team-level sliding-minute requests counter. gw:rl:tpm:team:{teamID}:{minute} String (Int) window_seconds * 2 (120s) Rate Limiter: Team-level sliding-minute tokens counter. gw:spend:team:{teamID} String (Int) None (Persistent Counter) FinOps: Team-level spend accumulator. gw:rl:rpm:org:{orgID}:{minute} String (Int) window_seconds * 2 (120s) Rate Limiter: Organization-level sliding-minute requests counter. gw:rl:tpm:org:{orgID}:{minute} String (Int) window_seconds * 2 (120s) Rate Limiter: Organization-level sliding-minute tokens counter. gw:spend:org:{orgID} String (Int) None (Persistent Counter) FinOps: Organization-level spend accumulator. gw:cache:resp:{sha256(req)} String (JSON) Configured Cache TTL (default 1h) Response Cache: Exact-match cached CanonicalChatResponse. gw:router:cooldown:{depID} String router.default_cooldown (default 60s) Circuit Breaker: Cooldown lock asserting deployment is in OPEN state. gw:lock:discovery String 60s Discovery Worker: Distributed leader election lock preventing duplicate sync sweeps. gw:mcp:hdl:{handle} String (JSON) mcp.handle_ttl (default 1h) MCP Discovery: 256-bit opaque tool handle record binding. gw:events:invalidation Pub/Sub Channel N/A Cluster Invalidation: Broadcasts L1 cache eviction events when keys or policies mutate. gw:a2a:events:{taskID} Pub/Sub Channel N/A A2A Streaming: Real-time event bus broadcasting SSE updates to connected subscribers. [!TIP] In production environments with multiple gateway pods, always configure Redis so that virtual key revocations and policy modifications broadcast via gw:events:invalidation take effect across all pods within milliseconds.

GoRoute AI Gateway features enterprise-grade observability tailored for high-volume inference infrastructure: Prometheus Metrics Engine (GET /metrics): In-process reservoir sampling of latencies, Time-To-First-Token (TTFT), routing overheads, cache-hit ratios, and provider spend. W3C Distributed Tracing: Strict traceparent and X-Trace-Id propagation from incoming clients through to upstream hyperscalers. Multi-Tier Health Probes: Kubernetes liveness (/healthz), readiness (/readyz), and active upstream deployment probing (/admin/v1/health/*). Orchestration & Scrapers GoRoute AI Gateway Upstream Providers Scrape 15s Liveness Check Readiness Check Trace Logs Outbound Traceparent Outbound Traceparent Prometheus Scraper K8s Kubelet Probes OpenTelemetry Collector GET /metrics(Text Format 0.0.4) GET /healthz GET /readyz GET /admin/v1/health/deploymentsPOST /admin/v1/health/probe W3C Trace Middleware(00-{trace}-{span}-01) OpenAI API Anthropic API

The gateway exposes a dedicated, unauthenticated Prometheus scraper endpoint at GET /metrics formatted according to Prometheus exposition specification 0.0.4. Metrics are maintained in-memory using an efficient fixed-size reservoir sampler (1,024 samples) with zero lock contention on the hot path.

Metric Name Type Labels Description gateway_requests_total Counter — Total inference requests processed across all endpoints. gateway_errors_total Counter — Total failed inference requests (HTTP 4xx/5xx). gateway_latency_ms Gauge quantile="0.5", "0.95", "0.99" End-to-end request duration percentiles in milliseconds. gateway_ttft_ms Gauge quantile="0.95" P95 Time-To-First-Token for streaming responses in milliseconds. gateway_routing_overhead_micros Gauge quantile="0.95" P95 Stage 1 (heuristic) + Stage 2 (load balancer) routing decision time in microseconds. gateway_fallbacks_total Counter — Total failover executions to secondary or tertiary model groups. gateway_retries_total Counter — Total intra-group exponential retry attempts. gateway_cache_hits_total Counter — Total exact-match responses served directly from Redis/L1 cache. gateway_ratelimit_rejections_total Counter — Total requests rejected by RPM/TPM rate limits or financial spend ceilings. gateway_guardrail_blocks_total Counter — Total requests intercepted and blocked by security guardrail rules. gateway_provider_requests_total Counter provider Request volume segmented by upstream provider (openai, anthropic, etc.). gateway_provider_errors_total Counter provider Upstream failure count segmented by provider. gateway_provider_latency_p95_ms Gauge provider P95 upstream round-trip latency segmented by provider. gateway_provider_spend_micros_total Counter provider Cumulative spend in integer micro-dollars (10^-6 USD) per provider. gateway_deployment_requests_total Counter deployment_id, name, provider Requests routed to specific provider model deployments. gateway_deployment_errors_total Counter deployment_id, name, provider Upstream failures per individual deployment.
